name: World War 3
overview: Scripture reveals that the signs of global conflict, including wars and rumors of wars, are part of the unfolding events before Christ’s return, though believers are reminded not to be troubled as these are not the end yet (Matthew 24:6). The Bible warns of a future time of unprecedented tribulation, calling Christians to remain watchful and prayerful, always prepared for the Lord’s coming, which no one knows the exact time of except the Father (Matthew 24:21, 24:36, 24:42; Luke 21:36). Central to this message is the hope found in God's love through Jesus Christ, who offers eternal life to all who believe, assuring believers of victory beyond the trials of this world (John 3:16).
